item.title: SA’s Sterne two behind leader Reed at Qatar Open
item.description: Patrick Reed surged to the top of the Qatar Open leaderboard after day two, posting a 67 to move to 12 under par and a one-shot lead over Sweden’s Joakim Lagergren.

item.title: Cape Town Open leader Fisher Jnr hungry to win again
item.description: Trevor Fisher Jnr will take a slender lead into the weekend of the Circa Cape Town Open after carding a composed second-round 67 at Royal Cape Golf Club on Friday.

item.title: Hisatsune leads Matsuyama at Phoenix Open
item.description: Ryo Hisatsune rode a back-nine binge to an eight-under par 63 on Friday to take a one-shot lead over fellow Japanese Hideki Matsuyama at the PGA Tour's Phoenix Open.

item.title: 15-year-old wins Africa Amateur Women’s Invitational
item.description: Rising star Lisa Coetzer completed a standout week at Royal Johannesburg to win the Africa Amateur Women’s Invitational at Royal Johannesburg.

item.title: Smylie, Uihlein set for historic LIV showdown
item.description: A final-round shootout beckons as LIV Golf stages its first four-round event with the leaders, Elvis Smylie and Peter Uihlein, level in Riyadh.

item.title: Watch: Streamer banned from PGA Tour events
item.description: What happened when streamer Jack Doherty offered a fan $100 to yell "jackass" during Mackenzie Hughes backswing at the WM Phoenix Open.

item.title: Reed builds two-shot lead in Qatar
item.description: Patrick Reed will take a two-shot lead into Sunday's final round of the Qatar Masters.

item.title: Cool Fisher Jnr maintains Cape Town Open lead
item.description: Trevor Fisher Jnr took another casual stroll around 18 holes at Royal Cape Golf Club on Saturday.

item.title: Matsuyama grabs Phoenix Open lead
item.description: Hideki Matsuyama fired a three-under par 68 to seize a one-stroke lead after Saturday’s third round of the PGA Tour's Phoenix Open.

item.title: Smylie wins on LIV Golf debut, Saffa shares ninth
item.description: Elvis Smylie produced four outstanding rounds to claim a one-shot victory on debut at Roshn Group LIV Golf Riyadh.
